kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستأيك (form X)
# أَسْتَأْيِكُ (ʔastaʔyiku) /ʔas.taʔ.ji.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# أَسْتَأْيِكَ (ʔastaʔyika) /ʔas.taʔ.ji.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# أَسْتَأْيِكْ (ʔastaʔyik) /ʔas.taʔ.jik/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
